provenance.source: PR #1255 feat(SIGINT): better handle interrupts, merged 2024-12-02
provenance.note: the base sends on the message channel from the signal handler with the same missing guard, so the PR rewrote this send into a two-message switch without repairing it; the later fix guards the send on the program's context and ships a regression test

keywords: no receiver left to read it
bugs.note: the handler writes the interrupt message straight onto the program's message channel with no way out; once the event loop has stopped nothing reads that channel, so the handler never returns, and shutdown waits for the handlers it started
